items.title: How NVDA Stock Rises To $235?
items.summary: NVIDIA's (NVDA) board unanimously reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as President, CEO, and director on November 23, 2026, igniting a roughly 30% intraday surge in NVDA shares during Monday morning trading (lifting the stock from Friday's 52-week closing low of $125.53 into the $160+ range, with early trades briefly topping $170.
